title: The Nest Cobblemon
description: A minimalistic Vanilla+ modpack that blends Minecraft’s core survival with seamless Pokémon integration. Enjoy smooth performance, enhanced UI, backpacks, and quality-of-life tweaks — all while keeping the familiar charm of vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# The Nest Cobblemon
_A streamlined Vanilla+ experience with Pokémon by your side._

This pack builds on the foundation of Minecraft’s survival with thoughtful enhancements that keep the game familiar, yet more immersive and rewarding. Explore an optimized world with subtle quality-of-life tweaks, improved performance, and light survival refinements — all without straying far from the vanilla feel.

Cobblemon is seamlessly integrated, letting Pokémon naturally coexist with your adventures. Catch, train, and battle without losing the charm of Minecraft’s core gameplay.

### Key Features

- Cobblemon Integration – Pokémon spawn, battle, and grow alongside your survival world.
 
- Performance Enhancements – Optimized to keep the game smooth, even with Pokémon roaming around.
 
- Enhanced UI – Cleaner menus, improved HUD elements, and better accessibility in everyday play.
 
- Backpacks & Storage Upgrades – Carry more on your adventures without endless trips home.
 
- Detailed Battle Feedback – Clear move descriptions and mechanics help you make smarter decisions in fights.
 
- Vanilla+ Quality of Life – Subtle tweaks to exploration, building, and survival that preserve the vanilla feel while smoothing out rough edges.
 
- Minimal clutter. No unnecessary bloat. Just a smooth, balanced blend of Minecraft + Pokémon.
